interactions.user: tell me a random fun fact about octopuses
interactions.assistant: there, Did you know octopuses are quite fascinating creatures? Here's an interesting tidbit: each arm of an octopus has its own ganglion, which is essentially a mini-brain! This allows for better coordination and movement of the arms independently. As for their circulatory system, while they do have three hearts, it might be more accurate to say that two pump blood to the gills and one pumps it to the rest of the body - that's some intricate biology right there! Next checks: - Research the exact function of the third "heart" in octopuses. - Confirm if each arm has a ganglion or just two arms (arms 1 and 8) have these mini-brains.
